QUOTE: "Deny is the last gate. It is checked in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval. `check_approval` only consults the allow list."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places deny in ServerManager::execute, but it doesn't conclude that deny is the only list that blocks execution. It describes the allow list as gating approval, so an unapproved call is refused at the approval step.
